d:
Finding Bigfoot brings together the team's most intriguing investigations from Season 2. From mysterious footprints and unexplained sounds to sightings deep in the wilderness, every clue brings them closer to the elusive creature. But will their search finally lead to proof of Bigfoot?
Watch Finding Bigfoot, Season 2, Episodes 5, 7, 3, 6, 1, 10, 2 and 8, on Discovery Channel India.
